# The Disciplined Club

> A system to become your best self: the full course, a new module every month, and simple routines built to work on your lowest days — not another course full of weak information.

## What it is
The Disciplined Club is a paid online program. Every member gets immediate access to the full course and a new module every month, covering habits, mindset, physical discipline and high-income skills. The higher tier adds a weekly live Q&A with the community and a private WhatsApp accountability group. It is an environment and a system for taking action, not just a folder of videos.

## Who it is for
Ambitious people who feel stuck or unsure where to start and want structure, accountability, and systems that hold up on the days they do not feel like it. It is not for people who want results without consistent effort.

## Offer
Two plans, both quoted including VAT (the exact amount depends on the buyer's country):
- The Discipline Plan: EUR 34.95 incl. VAT.
  Immediate access to the full course, a new video every month, cancel anytime with no long-term commitment.
  Checkout: not published yet.
- The Discipline + Plan: EUR 149.95 incl. VAT.
  Everything above plus a weekly Q&A with the community, a private WhatsApp accountability group, and monthly updated content so members keep growing after the first 90 days.
  Checkout: not published yet.

## How it works
1. Watch Module 1 — Habits: morning and evening routines that stick without willpower.
2. Watch Modules 2-5 — Mind, Body & Income: mindset, physical discipline, and high-income skills.
3. Become that person: inner alignment, cutting the people and habits keeping you stuck.
4. Implement and stay focused: apply it in real life, new content every month, stay accountable.
